steps.text: As Mara, open the tool chest with Nico.
Switch to Nico to read the cipher on his old badge.
Read the witness list hidden under the false floor.
Switch to Mara for the getaway.
Drive to the waterfront rendezvous. Nico will intercept the radio call.
Stay at the rendezvous while Nico listens.
Tell Ines what your father was protecting.
As Mara, get Leila’s service entrance invitation.
Switch to Nico to search the service records.
Copy the guest transfer order from the hotel cabinet.
Switch to Mara for the road out.
Return to Old Quarter. Nico will follow with the original.
Reconcile the recording and the witness transfer.
Meet Aunt Ines at Café Lucero.
Take the Solano to Port Sol.
Collect Rafi’s water-stained envelope.
Bring the envelope into Vale Motors.
Ask Sora about the missing medical shipment.
Find the unmarked medical crate.
Drive the crate to Santa Clara’s rear gate.
Lose the patrols without leading them back to the clinic.
Give Dr. Celia the shipment.
Meet Leila in Mariposa’s back room.
Drive to Hotel Maravilla without drawing a patrol.
Copy the service-hall guest register beside the right-hand cabinet.
Bring Nico the copied registration.
Ask the night porter when the courier is leaving.
Take the courier’s Azul GT from the rear parking bay.
Get the footage out of Playa Azul before the checkpoint closes.
Lose the patrols. Do not lead them to Leila.
Give Leila the camera card.
Inspect the abandoned diver’s bag.
Ask Alma at the Municipal Archive about the permit.
Read the amended dredging permit.
Find Mara at Vale Motors.
Copy the duplicate shipping register.
Walk to the customs observation point.
Watch the container yard through one unloading cycle.
Ask Sora who worked the midnight shift.
Give Alma a copy of the register.
Ask the porter about the sealed room.
Search the laundry cabinet at the back right of the room.
Ask Blue Current who treated a cut hand.
Record Ellin’s name in Alma’s duplicate file.
Get Ivo’s coordinates for the damaged buoy.
Reach the beach survey marker.
Recover the buoy’s recording unit.
Match the buoy’s date to the shipping log.
As Mara, plan the family’s departure with Sora.
Switch to Nico at the grid relay.
Open the relay and give Mara a window.
Switch to Mara for the family’s drive.
Bring the family’s vehicle to Old Quarter before the window closes.
Let Ines take the family upstairs.
As Nico, get Teo’s machine access number.
Copy the trust’s payment ledger.
Switch to Mara to clear the way out.
Clear the security crew from the extraction junction.
Switch to Nico with the copied ledger.
Give Alma the ledger and Ellin’s location.
As Mara, get Ellin ready to move.
Switch to Nico at the ridge radio.
Broadcast Ellin’s identity on the emergency band.
Switch to Mara with the witness.
Bring Ellin to the ridge transfer junction.
Confirm the witness route with June.
As Nico, get June’s final route warning.
Clear the witness road’s private checkpoint.
Switch to Mara for the final descent.
Bring Ellin down to Port Sol.
Hand Ellin over to Sora in person.
Meet dispatcher Teo at Cinder Freight.
Copy the shift-change relay schedule.
Check the crate beside the foundry cabinet.
Leave the crate with the independent mechanics.
Get the order archive from Diesel.
Take the Cinder box truck.
Drive the order archive through the west checkpoint.
Stop Meridian’s road crew before they seize the truck.
Leave the alerted patrols behind.
Store the orders outside Meridian’s reach.
Ask ranger June about Pine House.
Take June’s loaned Sierra RS.
Bring the field medicine along the ridge road.
Meet Ellin at Pine House.
Return June’s medical case.
Locate the last outbound quarry invoice.
Take the abandoned quarry pickup.
Get the invoice down to the southern ridge junction.
Clear Meridian’s recovery crew from the junction.
Let Diesel verify the vehicle’s load record.
Get the original inspection stamp.
Compare the demolition order with the customs stamp.
Record the substation maintenance broadcast.
File the forgery evidence with Alma.
Collect Teo’s private-band receiver.
Keep Meridian’s collectors away from dispatch.
Decode the relay’s stored channel list.
Put Teo under the union’s protection.
Hear Ellin’s account at Pine House.
Photograph Ellin’s treatment notes.
Get June’s original rescue entry.
File the rescue entry beside the false death report.
Compare the closed quarry books with the new invoice.
Reach the old survey overlook.
Record the relay’s automatic account call.
Trace the account call to its billing address.
As Nico, enter the donor preview.
Switch to Mara outside the reception.
Keep Meridian’s retrieval team out of the gallery.
Switch back to Nico at the locked register.
Use the copied access card and preserve the register.
Leave the recording and register in legal custody.
As Nico, collect Serrano’s sealed evidence box.
Break the private security cordon below Mirador.
Switch to Mara for the coastal run.
Carry the evidence to the Playa Azul coast.
Entrust the survey trail to Gideon at Blue Current.
Ask Leila for a name on the Mirador guest list.
Confront the bank’s private collector.
Stop the collectors outside the public banking lane.
Copy the collector’s routing receipt.
Bring Leila proof the collection office is compromised.
Take the donor’s valet delivery order.
Collect the donor’s Ferrari 458.
Drive the Ferrari to the eastern handover.
Copy the card from the valet pouch.
Return the donor’s car to Casa Serrat.
Leave the copied card with attorney Serrano.
Ask Gideon to guide you through Salt Marsh.
Collect the community’s Llano van.
Collect the fishers’ families at the market road.
Bring the families and dry records to Santa Marea.
Check the families into the refuge.
Make Rafi explain the debt he bought.
Read Rafi’s original debt transfer.
Keep Meridian’s eviction crew away from the refuge.
Let the families decide whether Rafi can help.
Ask Serrano to challenge the coastal transfer.
Photograph the foundation’s first donor notice.
Compare the sole resident’s name with the death register.
Submit the false hearing notice and death entry.
Read the account’s scheduled collection time.
Reach the east-road observation point.
Record the courier’s departure on the quiet road.
Match the courier reference to a marshland company.
Ask Serrano how to preserve the original survey.
Ask surveyor Ada for the unamended coast map.
Photograph the first brass boundary post.
Photograph the boardwalk’s original survey marker.
Match the physical markers to Ada’s field book.
Read the station’s original tide chart.
Ask who saw the supposed rescue convoy.
Compare the convoy with the airfreight register.
Put the tide report and charter in Serrano’s custody.
As Nico, collect Ada’s signed originals.
Switch to Mara at the refuge road.
Hold the refuge road against the clearance team.
Switch to Nico with the signed survey.
Send the survey on the emergency archive channel.
Tell Ada the coast is on the public record.
As Mara, take Gideon’s message for the Northlight mechanic.
Switch to Nico at the field station.
Preserve the airstrip’s old public right of way.
Open the blocked coast junction.
Switch to Mara for the Northlight approach.
Reach Northlight before the freight charter leaves.
Ask Vera to stop the Northlight charter.
Recover Vera’s replacement fuel regulator.
Give Vera the regulator and charter number.
Help Vera isolate the grounded aircraft’s fuel system.
Get Voss’s message from the controller.
Take the controller’s Albatros estate.
Carry the mechanic along the lighthouse road.
Keep the retrieval team away from the keeper’s road.
Hand the mechanic over to the keeper.
Ask the controller about the silent freight charter.
Preserve the controller’s signed paper log.
Reach the old runway timing marker.
Match the runway timer to the recorded landing interval.
Match the interval to the trust’s cargo docket.
Ask the keeper for Elias’s last recording.
Listen to the complete recording.
File the confession with the rest of the evidence.
Tell Mara what their father actually said.
As Mara, confirm the aircraft is safely grounded.
Defend the grounded plane from Meridian’s extraction crew.
Switch to Nico at the freight terminal.
Take Captain Voss’s signed witness statement.
Seal the original demolition authorization.
Put the complete case into Serrano’s custody.
As Nico, hear Serrano’s final terms.
Leave one sealed duplicate with Alma.
Switch to Mara for the drive to the light.
Take the coastal road to the lighthouse.
Switch to Nico at the lighthouse.
With Mara, decide what the Vale name will mean.
As Nico, hear the drivers at Island Line.
Switch to Mara beside the dispatch house.
Take a vehicle to the eastern pickup.
Switch to Nico to clear the return service.
Sign the public return timetable.
Return to Mara at the eastern pickup.
Bring the first shift’s pay packet to La Sal.
As Mara, warn the family at San Telmo.
Switch to Nico at the Northlight annex.
Check the collectors’ claimed order.
Stop the armed collectors outside Northlight.
Switch to Mara with the family at San Telmo.
Bring a vehicle down the ridge.
Leave the family with Sister Sol.
As Mara, accept Gideon’s trial charter.
Take the charter launch beside the port dock.
Follow the channel to the outer marker, then stop.
Moor the launch and switch to Nico at Radio Sal.
Register the return call on the public band.
Return to Mara at the moored launch.
Reboard the charter launch and return to the dock.
Give Gideon the signed public route card.
Ask Berto about the unclaimed car.
Take the recovered Brisa from the yard.
Show the owner the car at Port Sol.
Leave the recovered registration with the desk sergeant.
Collect June’s sealed supply list.
Take June’s Sierra RS.
Take La Costa’s eastern bend.
Follow the coast road past Northlight.
Deliver the supplies inside San Telmo.
Hear Ada’s plan at Radio Sal.
Copy the original coast register.
Meet La Sal’s crew outside the market.
Let the fishers check the family names.
File a public duplicate at Northlight.
Ask Sister Sol for the refuge register.
Read Sol’s old household repair ledger.
Check the names against Ada’s callers.
Return the signed family corrections.
As Nico, sit with Ines one more time.
Leave the final unedited route book with Alma.
Switch to Mara at Vale Motors.
Take the family’s restored Solano.
Drive down to the harbour for the last handover.
Switch to Nico outside the customs house.
With Mara, choose the life after the case.

limits: Prototype graphics are below the observed OneState reference.
Most missions use shared driving, interaction, evidence and combat systems rather than custom cinematic levels.
Only the two opening operations were played naturally end to end; broad later coverage uses explicitly labelled fixtures and rule tests.
Desktop Chrome and desktop WebKit were observed; no physical phone was tested.
NPC intelligence, vehicle physics, interiors, dialogue and animation are simplified; traffic uses original approximate car bodies.
The observation wheel is a decorative animated landmark, not a simulated ride.
